messages.content: It's vegan
The best model I've tried so far. It drives just like Duck Amigo (which is good). Amazing lateral for my 2021 Hyundai Palisade.
A good all-round model with NNLC and with predictive long tune. No lateral wobble on the highway after online lateral is calibrated, so it's pretty chill.

tried it again this morning on the highway.  It was pretty tolerable but the "kinda-far" lead behavior was overly cautious, would start slowing down too progressively with >80m to the target, had to intercept with throttle a few times
VFF and default (vegan filet o fish) are both in the selector. Assuming it’s the same thing?
We are seeing this model hug the right side of the lane pretty badly and sometimes drift into the shoulder
We’re thinking it’s because of the newly added lagd daemon, because it worked flawlessly on FP (which is running agnos 10)
For me it does really good on highway, but any other condition hugs either line too much for my liking (on FP)
So far VFF has the highest lateral torque I have tried and that’s without NNLC, I’m going to try vegetarian FF next after trying VFF with NNLC
Vegetarian fof is pretty decent
That’s what I’m seeing as well, and I always drive on roads with lane lines so it may be the best I’ve used so far.
I wish that were the case for me. maybe 50% of my roads are painted, and that's being generous

This model has the best lateral for my 22 Honda accord, but like many have said, it likes to hug the line too much (for me it’s left line), if  fixed, could be one of the best.  Tomb raider 7 is very good, it’s smooth and keep car at center  but not as good on lateral as VFF
I’m hoping they can combine the good lateral with the intelligence of the TR series of models
Tr is mlsim, that’s why it’s so good
Do we know why it doesn’t ask for as much lateral as the old models?
Could be your car, I can almost do unassisted U-turns on the tr models

I get much higher lateral torque on vegetarian FoF than I do on any of the TR models. I run the same cloverleaf on the way to work and TR models can take it around 29-30mph before they cannot handle the turn. Vegetarian FoF can take it at 34-35mph.
Interesting how these models work so different on different vehicles
Agreed, it would be interesting to be able to see why that is
